description: Find a person's Chinese zodiac animal from a birth year or date (handles the Lunar New Year and Start of Spring boundaries for January–February births) and return the 2027 Year of the Fire Goat forecast for that sign: love, career, money and a tip.

birth_date.description: Birth year (YYYY) or full date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full date is needed to be exact for January–February births.

language.description: Output language. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese: Japanese card / hexagram names, meanings and links to the Japanese pages. Otherwise "en".

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace (e.g. "America/New_York"). Only matters for births near the Start of Spring in early February.

name: chinese_zodiac
title: Chinese zodiac sign and 2027 forecast
